```{r}
#| context: setup
#| output: false

library(shiny)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
library(stringr)
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
 
conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")

# Shared visual language for every plot and table.
theme_runnr <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(colour = "#243E38"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E7ECE8", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "#60716B"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#243E38"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(14, 16, 10, 10)
    )
}

dashboard_table <- function(data, page_length = 10) {
  datatable(data, rownames = FALSE, class = "stripe hover",
    options = list(pageLength = page_length, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(),
                   language = list(search = "Search", lengthMenu = "Show _MENU_ rows")))
}

# Import and prepare running data -----------------------------------------
parse_run_date <- function(x) {
  # Match complete dates explicitly: guessing/truncation can interpret
  # 8/8/2011 as 2008-08-20 and accept mistyped years such as 0023.
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  result <- as.Date(rep(NA_character_, length(x)))
  formats <- c(
    "^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$" = "%m/%d/%Y",
    "^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{2}$" = "%m/%d/%y",
    "^\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}$" = "%Y-%m-%d"
  )
  for (pattern in names(formats)) {
    matched <- !is.na(x) & grepl(pattern, x)
    result[matched] <- as.Date(x[matched], format = formats[[pattern]])
  }
  # These are modern running logs. Flag implausible years instead of
  # guessing a correction or expanding the chart across centuries.
  invalid <- !is.na(result) & (year(result) < 1900 | year(result) > year(Sys.Date()) + 1)
  result[invalid] <- NA
  rejected <- !is.na(x) & nzchar(x) & is.na(result)
  if (any(rejected)) {
    warning("Unrecognized running dates (excluded from date-based summaries): ",
            paste(unique(x[rejected]), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  result
}

running <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQ6WOA3AOFScjC94zIYvHhjCz20iWZDclAD8NJZyTlLJKYmsTWnsJiYvHqnhdRIELgovhujvIwNEUQv/pub?gid=0&single=true&output=csv")
running <- running[, -16]
running$avg_hr <- as.numeric(running$avg_hr)

names(running) <- c(
  "date", "time", "distance_miles", "avg_heart_rate", "pace", "notes",
  "training_cycle", "easy", "long", "interval", "threshold", "recovery",
  "hard", "race", "cross_training"
)

running <- running %>%
  mutate(run_type = case_when(
    easy == 1 ~ "easy",
    long == 1 ~ "long",
    interval == 1 ~ "vo2_max",
    threshold == 1 ~ "lactate_threshold",
    recovery == 1 ~ "recovery",
    hard == 1 ~ "vo2_max",
    race == 1 ~ "race"
  )) %>%
  select(date:pace, run_type)
running$date <- parse_run_date(running$date)

running2 <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRD-AMfL1-tco3MorSqva8nmAgkjNnd-Ujhy4vdaPs5bl9rSdiSPTqb_1_PyXe7DQQVw4eSddQJSaTb/pub?gid=1481357316&single=true&output=csv") 

names(running2) <- c(
  "date", "distance_miles", "time", "avg_heart_rate", "shoe", "run_type",
  "notes", "running_partner", "partner_name", "time_stamp", "RPE"
)
running2  <- running2 %>% 
  filter(distance_miles > 0)
running2$date <- parse_run_date(running2$date)
running$shoe <- NA
running <- bind_rows(running, running2) %>%
  mutate(
    time2 = case_when(nchar(time) <= 6 ~ paste0(time, ":00"), TRUE ~ time),
    time3 = str_sub(time2, 1, str_length(time2) - 3),
    time_min_sec = ms(time3),
    time_sec = period_to_seconds(time_min_sec),
    pace_sec = time_sec / distance_miles,
    pace_sec_period = seconds_to_period(pace_sec),
    year = year(date),
    week = week(date),
    month = month(date),
    month_uid = floor_date(date, unit = "month"),
    week_uid = floor_date(date, unit = "week", week_start = 1)
  ) %>%
  select(-time2, -time3)

retired_shoes <- c(
  "saucony_red", "netwon_kimset_orange", "kinvara_7_green",
  "2020_02_clifton", "2020_03_clifton_grey", "triumph", "brooks_levitate",
  "kinvara_8_water", "saucony_peregrine", "2019_01_triumph",
  "2021_03_saucony_kinvara", "2021_02_clifton_franklin",
  "2019_10_saucony_freedom", "2023_09_altra_lone", '2023_08_hoka_mach5',
  '2024_01_topo_flilyte4', '2023_03_altra_rivera', '2024_05_topo_specter'
)

shoe_miles_table <- running %>%
  group_by(shoe) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(distance_miles), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(shoe)) %>%
  filter_out(str_detect(shoe, 'elliptical|2021|2022|2023|2024')) |> 
  mutate(active = if_else(shoe %in% retired_shoes, 0, 1)) %>%
  filter(active == 1) %>%
  select(-active) %>%
  separate(shoe, c("year", "month", "make", "model"), sep = "_")

active_shoe_run_type_totals <- running %>%
  filter(!is.na(shoe), !shoe %in% retired_shoes) %>%
  filter_out(str_detect(shoe, 'elliptical|2021|2022|2023|2024')) |> 
  mutate(shoe_label = str_to_title(str_replace_all(shoe, "_", " "))) %>%
  group_by(shoe_label, run_type) %>%
  summarise(total_miles = sum(distance_miles, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(shoe_label = fct_reorder(shoe_label, total_miles, .fun = sum))

running$hr_zone <- cut(
  running$avg_heart_rate,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 137, 146, 158, 164, 177),
  labels = c("Recovery", "Easy", "Med/Long/MP", "Lac_Thresh", "Interval")
)

run_types <- sort(unique(na.omit(running$run_type)))
run_colors <- setNames(rep(c("#267D71", "#B47939", "#647EB0", "#A45D74",
                            "#7A8545", "#805DA3", "#4D94A2", "#A65443",
                            "#536D59", "#93816B"), length.out = length(run_types)), run_types)
run_labels <- function(x) str_to_sentence(str_replace_all(x, "_", " "))

weekly_totals <- running %>%
  group_by(week_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    total_miles = sum(distance_miles),
    week_start = as.Date(first(week_uid)),
    week_end = as.Date(first(week_uid + 6)),
    n_runs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_totals <- running %>%
  group_by(month_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    total_miles = sum(distance_miles),
    month = first(month),
    year = first(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_choices <- list(
  "Date" = "date",
  "Duration" = "time",
  "Distance (miles)" = "distance_miles",
  "Average heart rate" = "avg_heart_rate",
  "Pace (min/mi)" = "pace_sec",
  "Run type" = "run_type",
  "Shoes worn" = "shoe",
  "Year" = "year",
  "Week" = "week",
  "Month" = "month",
  "RPE" = "RPE"
)

# Calendar metrics. Weeks always begin on Monday.
current_week_start <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), unit = "week", week_start = 1)
previous_week_start <- current_week_start - weeks(1)
two_weeks_ago_start <- current_week_start - weeks(2)
current_month_start <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), unit = "month")
current_year_start <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), unit = "year")

miles_in_period <- function(start_date, end_date) {
  running %>%
    filter(date >= start_date, date < end_date) %>%
    summarise(miles = sum(distance_miles, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(miles)
}

two_weeks_ago_miles <- miles_in_period(two_weeks_ago_start, previous_week_start)
previous_week_miles <- miles_in_period(previous_week_start, current_week_start)
weekly_change <- if (two_weeks_ago_miles > 0) {
  100 * ((previous_week_miles - two_weeks_ago_miles) / two_weeks_ago_miles)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

current_week_miles <- miles_in_period(current_week_start, current_week_start + weeks(1))
current_month_miles <- miles_in_period(current_month_start, current_month_start + months(1))
current_year_miles <- miles_in_period(current_year_start, current_year_start + years(1))
lifetime_miles <- sum(running$distance_miles, na.rm = TRUE)

format_miles <- function(miles) {
  paste0(format(round(miles, 1), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " mi")
}
```

```{r}
#| context: server
#| output: true 

output$pace_date_plot <- renderPlot({
  pace_p <- running %>%
    filter(
      date >= input$dates[1],
      date <= input$dates[2],
      distance_miles <= input$max_distance
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = date,
      y = pace_sec,
      colour = factor(run_type),
      group = factor(run_type)
    )) +
    theme_runnr() +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = run_colors, labels = run_labels, na.value = "#99A5A0") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_time() +
    labs(color = "Run type", x = "Date", y = "Pace (min/mile)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
    )

  if ("smooth" %in% input$pace_plot) {
    pace_p <- pace_p + geom_smooth()
  }
  if ("facet" %in% input$pace_plot) {
    pace_p <- pace_p + facet_wrap(~factor(run_type))
  }
  pace_p
})

output$weekly_mileage_plot <- renderPlot({
  weekly_totals %>%
    filter( week_uid >= input$dates[1],
      week_uid <= input$dates[2]) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = week_start, y = total_miles)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#267D71", width = 6) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b\n%Y", breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
    labs(x = "Week starting", y = "Miles") +
    theme_runnr() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
})

output$shoe_run_type_plot <- renderPlot({
  active_shoe_run_type_totals %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = shoe_label, y = total_miles, fill = run_type)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 400, colour = "#A65443", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = run_colors, labels = run_labels, na.value = "#99A5A0") +
    labs(x = "Active shoe", y = "Miles", fill = "Run type") +
    theme_runnr() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
})

daily_runs_table <- function() {
  running %>%
    arrange(desc(date)) %>%
    select(
      Date = date,
      Time = time,
      Distance = distance_miles,
      Pace = pace_sec_period,
      Type = run_type,
      Shoe = shoe
    ) %>%
    mutate(Pace = round(Pace, digits = 2))
}

active_shoe_table <- function() {
  shoe_miles_table %>%
    mutate(across(c(year, month), as.numeric)) %>%
    arrange(desc(year), desc(month)) %>%
    mutate(
      month = month.abb[month],
      date = paste0(month, " ", year),
      make = str_to_title(make),
      model = str_to_title(model)
    ) %>%
    select(Make = make, Model = model, Distance = sum, Started = date)
}

output$activity_daily_runs <- renderDT({
  dashboard_table(daily_runs_table())
})

output$activity_shoe_mileage <- renderDT({
  dashboard_table(active_shoe_table())
})

output$weekly_mileage_table <- renderDT({
  weekly_totals %>%
    arrange(desc(week_uid)) %>%
    select(Start = week_start, End = week_end, Distance = total_miles, n = n_runs) %>%
    dashboard_table()
})

output$table_shoe_mileage <- renderDT({
  dashboard_table(active_shoe_table())
})

output$table_daily_runs <- renderDT({
  dashboard_table(daily_runs_table())
})

output$monthly_mileage_table <- renderDT({
  monthly_totals %>%
    arrange(desc(month_uid)) %>%
    mutate(month = month.name[month]) %>%
    select(Month = month, Year = year, Distance = total_miles) %>%
    dashboard_table(page_length = 12)
})

output$pace_distance_plot <- renderPlot({
  running %>%
    filter(distance_miles < input$max_distance) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$x_axis]], y = .data[[input$y_axis]])) +
    theme_runnr() +
    geom_point(aes(colour = factor(hr_zone)), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Recovery" = "#647EB0", "Easy" = "#267D71",
      "Med/Long/MP" = "#B47939", "Lac_Thresh" = "#A45D74", "Interval" = "#805DA3"),
      na.value = "#99A5A0") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(color = "Heart rate zone")
})
```
